Every event below qualified on ct24 plus ctk. That pairing is the Czech rule; for the non-Czech events (US midterms, Commission report, Fico) ct24 and ctk are used as the two lists, as the 2026-11-04 file did with ct24 for the midterms. World events seen on one list cannot be qualified and are in not_qualified, so the world side of this check is weak: the absence of a world event from 'missed' means not determined. BBC World was read as a cross-check but is not a coverage-1 list. The edition was frozen on 3 Nov at 05:32, before all these events, so 'covered' means it had a story on the event, not that it reported the outcome. Portal:Current_events (main page) entries below the 4 Nov heading belong to earlier days (RBA, midterms, Komyshuvakha) and were not used. Five web searches used of 6.
